scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agent-sidecar/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-sidecar/detectors build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agent-sidecar/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-sidecar/detectors build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agent-sidecar/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-sidecar/detectors build && vitest run --passWithNoTests
